name: Love from Outer Space
source:
This story follows a high school student named Amber, who moves to a new town with her parents because of her dad’s new job. While navigating her last two years of school, she reunites with her old friend Miranda. 

Along the way, Amber forms new friendships and encounters extraterrestrial beings.

From [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/Love_from_Outer_Space]romance-club.fandom[/url]
translation:
这个故事讲述了一位名叫安布尔的高中生，由于父亲的新工作，她和父母搬到了一个新城镇。在度过学校最后两年的时光时，她与老朋友米兰达重聚。

一路上，安布尔结识了新的朋友，并遇到了外星人。

来自 [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/Love_from_Outer_Space]romance-club.fandom[/url]
